requires: GLB 2.0 with embedded textures and skin
idle/run/attack/cast/hurt/death bound to actual distinct animation clips
normalized skin weights and valid joint indices
GGD vfx definitions and event scripts
resolved animation pulses, anchors and VFX references
excludes: placeholder movement or hurt mapped to idle

requires: six runtime states bound to actual animation clips; aliases explicitly reported
finite geometry and animation data; valid skin when present
model-body.scope: Reusable model and motion component only; not a complete character/VFX/SFX package.

note: Standardization is a reusable resource format check. It is not production publication, game balancing, complete visual fidelity, or GGD multiplayer acceptance. A standalone VFX library is not a complete character package. model-body is a standalone component profile; aliases are disclosed and cannot qualify for the stricter character profile.
